keyPhrases.text: unbridled praise has circled around The Ferryman
proclaimed a production not to be missed

reasoning: Strong positive review that explicitly states the production 'surpassed expectations' after acknowledging the high praise and hype. The critic was previously impressed by Butterworth's work and found this exceeded even those standards. Falls in 4/5 range due to enthusiastic recommendation without reaching 'masterpiece' level superlatives.
